origin: Original project-authored Blender/Python geometry and original Pillow twig/bark atlases
reference_use: Winter silhouette, age, crown openness and deadwood guidance only; no extracted pixels or downloaded meshes
units: Metres. Export meshes normalised to 1 m upright height. Existing canopy scales to 6-26 m; linked native preview instances are 18 m high.
axes: Blender +Z up; exported Godot +Y up. Origin is ground-root centre, all GLB node transforms identity.
collision: No physics in exports. Runtime existing trunk circles are retained; foliage/twigs never block walking.
surface_contract: One mesh/surface per GLB. Vertex alpha .10=dark bark, .18=birch bark, .65=near twig atlas, .72=far full-bough atlas, 1=solid snow. UV selects a padded tile or repeating bark. GLBs deliberately use the supplied Godot shader; native materials and four packed textures support Blender editing.
lod_contract: Shared trunk and primary crown skeleton. Near has crossed individual branchlet sprays and all resting snow caps; far uses composed full-bough coverage on two planes per limb, reduced branch cylinders and selected major caps. Far conifers <=500 triangles; bare trees <=1100.
negative_spec: No autumn leaf crowns, enormous snow pillows, copy of proprietary trees, foliage collision, moved scatter roots, changed height RNG or changed save keys
